summary: Enterprise Role Intelligence Phase B (Successor Assignment + Ask Previous Role) tested end-to-end on backend + web. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — candidates list excludes self, POST /successor generates a 15-item 30/60/90 checklist and an anonymized brief, GET /handoff returns {done,total,pct} correctly, toggling all items auto-flips transfer_status to 'complete' and reverts to 'in_progress' when unchecked, unknown item→404, empty question→400, unknown role→404. Ask Role returns grounded=true with real [S#] citations, is fully anonymized (no 'Raj/Priya/Amit' in any answer), and supports multi-turn history via session_id. Web UI: Priya Shah profile → Successor tab shows candidate dropdown (2 opts), Reassign button, anonymized handoff brief (948 chars, no personal names), 15 checklist items across 30/60/90 phases, progress bar hits 100% and 'Knowledge transfer complete' toast fires. Ask Role tab renders 3 suggestions, sends question via Enter, answer bubble shows [S3][S4][S6] tags + 3 citation pills, no personal names. One notable UX bug found: the 'AI Paralegal — Have you met' promo toast overlays the send-btn area in the bottom-right and intercepts clicks even with force=True — Enter key works as a workaround. Also a dev-only React hydration warning from the visual editor (span inside option in successor-select) which does not affect functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: The persistent 'AI Paralegal · New — Have you met AI Paralegal?' promo toast is anchored bottom-right and visually overlaps the ask-send-btn / bottom-right of ask-input. Playwright click(force=True) on [data-testid='ask-send-btn'] never triggered send(); only Enter key or clicking after dismissing the toast worked. Real users on smaller viewports (≤1440px) may hit the same issue. Suggest either (a) raising z-index of the ask input row above the promo toast, (b) dismissing/hiding the promo when the Ask Role tab is active, or (c) repositioning the promo to bottom-left.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — comes from the visual-editor's dev-time instrumentation adding x-* spans inside <option> elements in the successor-select. Dev-only, not visible in production, but should be filtered by visual-editor tooling.

action_items: Fix or dismiss the 'AI Paralegal' promo toast on the Ask Role screen so it doesn't overlap [data-testid='ask-send-btn'] (raise z-index of the input row, or hide the promo while on this tab).

(Optional / minor) The tab testID 'ptab-ask role' contains a space (from t.toLowerCase() where t="Ask Role"). Kebab-case it (e.g. 'ptab-ask-role') for stability across selector engines. Playwright handled it, but spaces in data-testid are brittle.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/enterprise.py line 58: `roles_no_successor = [r for r in roles.values() if not r.get('active_employee_user_id') or True]` — the `or True` short-circuits the whole condition to True, making the list identical to `roles.values()` and the variable is never used. Dead + misleading code; drop it or fix the predicate.

routes/enterprise.py get_handoff() line 300-301: `total = len(handoff['checklist']) if handoff else 0` then `done = sum(1 for c in handoff['checklist'] if c['done']) if handoff else 0` — safe today but the second expression evaluates `handoff['checklist']` before the `if handoff else 0` guard is checked. Works because of Python's ternary short-circuit, but re-order for clarity: guard once at the top, then compute.

services/enterprise_intelligence.py generate_handoff_brief(): the fallback branch is only hit when BOTH claude-fable-5 AND claude-sonnet-4-6 fail. If the LLM returns an empty string it will still be accepted (raw.strip() on ''). Consider validating min length before returning and falling back on empty output too.

services/enterprise_intelligence.py ask_previous_role(): the anonymization guarantee is enforced ONLY by the system prompt — there is no server-side post-filter on the answer text. All 9 backend tests confirm the model complies today, but this is a soft guarantee. Consider a defense-in-depth regex/name-blocklist filter (built from enterprise_users.employee_name for the workspace) that redacts to 'the previous role holder' if leakage ever occurs.

routes/enterprise.py ask_history() requires `session_id` as a mandatory query param (Depends via default). If a caller omits it, FastAPI returns 422 — fine, but consider allowing session_id-less history that returns the latest N sessions grouped, or at least documenting it.
EnterpriseProfile.jsx line 271: `data-testid={\`ptab-${t.toLowerCase()}\`}` produces 'ptab-ask role' with a space — brittle. Prefer `t.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-')`.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (core Successor + Ask Role flows work; one UX overlay issue on send-btn)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase B is stable — regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_enterprise_phase_b.py (9 tests, ~35s runtime, 4 of which hit Claude via Emergent LLM Key). Run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://... python -m pytest tests/test_enterprise_phase_b.py -v`. Note: FORBIDDEN_NAMES list ['Raj','Priya','Amit'] enforces the anonymization contract. If the seed changes personal names, update the constant. The 'ptab-ask role' testID contains a space — use exact match. When testing the send button on Ask Role, dismiss the AI Paralegal promo toast first OR press Enter to submit — force=True clicks alone are unreliable due to the toast overlay.
rca of the issue: AI Paralegal promo toast (bottom-right, z-index above the chat input row) overlays [data-testid='ask-send-btn']. Playwright's force=True bypasses the actionability check but the browser still dispatches the click at the target coordinate — since the toast sits on top at that point, the click can be captured by the toast's DOM subtree instead of the button. Enter-key submission bypasses the pointer path entirely and works reliably. Fix: bump z-index on the AskRoleTab bottom input container above the promo toast, or hide/lower the promo while /enterprise/people/:id is active.
